meta.environment: make a11y on a GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner and on a local macOS checkout; the audited page is the generated static file out/a11y/trace.html served by Lighthouse-CI's own static server, with no network. The scored metrics are transferred bytes, which measured 2469 total and 0 script on every run on every machine tried, so they are properties of the artifact rather than of the runner. lighthouse_performance is recorded for the record and is NOT scored, and the reason is a distribution rather than an anecdote: every score this repository recorded between 2026-08-28, when the gate landed, and 2026-09-06 was read back out of the job logs, 34 observations in all, and they span 0.77 to 1.00 on byte-identical input -- 26 at 1.00, three at 0.99, and one each at 0.94, 0.89, 0.87, 0.81 and 0.77. Four are below the 0.90 floor and the same four are more than 10% below this baseline. The disagreement is not only between commits: each ci run audits the same page twice, in the verify job and in the accessibility job, and CI runs 33581078870 and 33582650956 scored 1.00 and 0.81, and 1.00 and 0.77, on one commit in one run. This note previously described that spread from three observations. See perf/README.md for the full table and the run ids.
